"""F2 follow-up on an isolated disposable database; no application edits."""

import os
import uuid
from dataclasses import replace

import psycopg
import pytest

from agent_guard.ledger.migrate import apply_migrations
from agent_guard.ledger.provisioning import create_task_root
from agent_guard.ledger.service import ExecutionLedger
from tests.fixtures.state import build_tree


def test_used_revoked_root_cannot_be_deleted_and_reinserted_with_same_id():
    dsn = os.environ["AGENT_GUARD_TEST_DATABASE_URL"]
    with psycopg.connect(dsn, connect_timeout=5) as conn:
        assert conn.execute("SELECT current_database()").fetchone()[0] == "ag_review_f2"
        apply_migrations(conn)
        tree = build_tree(conn)
        root_id = "standalone-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        task_id = "standalone-task-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        create_task_root(
            conn,
            tenant_id=tree.tenant_id,
            task_id=task_id,
            grant_id=root_id,
            subject=tree.subject,
            holder_client_id=tree.planner[0],
            holder_kid=tree.planner[1],
            amount_limit=100000,
            call_limit=10,
            not_before=tree.not_before,
            expires_at=tree.expires_at,
        )
    request = replace(
        tree.invocation(grant_id=tree.root_id),
        task_id=task_id,
        grant_id=root_id,
        root_id=root_id,
        ancestor_ids=(),
    )
    ExecutionLedger(dsn).accept(request, tree.cost(amount_fen=70000))
    with psycopg.connect(dsn, connect_timeout=5) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE ag_grants SET revoked=TRUE, revoked_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE grant_id=%s",
            (root_id,),
        )
        assert conn.execute(
            "SELECT amount_reserved, calls_reserved, revoked FROM ag_grants WHERE grant_id=%s",
            (root_id,),
        ).fetchone() == (70000, 1, True)

    with pytest.raises(psycopg.IntegrityError):
        with psycopg.connect(dsn, connect_timeout=5) as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "CREATE TEMP TABLE old_root AS SELECT * FROM ag_grants WHERE grant_id=%s",
                (root_id,),
            )
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM ag_grants WHERE grant_id=%s", (root_id,))
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO ag_grants "
                "(grant_id,parent_grant_id,root_grant_id,tenant_id,task_id,subject,"
                "holder_client_id,holder_kid,depth,not_before,expires_at,amount_limit,call_limit) "
                "SELECT grant_id,parent_grant_id,root_grant_id,tenant_id,task_id,subject,"
                "holder_client_id,holder_kid,depth,not_before,expires_at,amount_limit,call_limit "
                "FROM old_root"
            )
    # A correct implementation must reject before commit and preserve the old state.
    with psycopg.connect(dsn, connect_timeout=5) as conn:
        assert conn.execute(
            "SELECT amount_reserved, calls_reserved, revoked FROM ag_grants WHERE grant_id=%s",
            (root_id,),
        ).fetchone() == (70000, 1, True)
